authorization.acceptance_slice: Produce one reproducible QST-ARCI-0001 synthetic-target assessment using the accepted ARCI v0.1 model: attach explicit evidence types and missing-data flags, keep score and confidence separate, run bounded weight and confidence sensitivity, and identify the next measurement without unsupported dollar valuation or queue/belief changes.
stop_conditions: Stop if the slice requires external observational evidence or representing the synthetic target as a real asteroid assessment.
Stop if small bounded weight perturbations cause major grade reversals; preserve the result as falsifying/limiting evidence rather than tuning weights to recover a headline grade.
Stop if implementation requires changing the ARCI scoring architecture, dimension ontology, or another major scientific route rather than exercising the accepted v0.1 model.
Stop before changing quests, queue membership or priority, consolidated beliefs, canonical memory, contracts, schemas, delegation law, workflows, or public/external claims.
Stop on failed mandatory validation, ownership conflict, source drift that invalidates this acceptance slice, or expansion beyond the declared file and transaction budgets.
authorization.next_action: Create or reuse one short-lived implementation owner for QST-ARCI-0001, encode one clearly synthetic target with evidence types and missing-data flags, run the accepted ARCI v0.1 score/confidence and bounded sensitivity analysis, emit one reproducible JSON assessment with a next-measurement recommendation, add focused tests, open exactly one implementation PR, and run the mandatory evaluator.
